title: Tagarangabotte ambush
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Tagarangabotte ambush", at revision 1370749494, opens: "The Ambush of Tagarangabotte took place during the Internal conflict in Azawad. A MUJAO column en route to Ménaka fell into an ambush by the MNLA." Wikidata item Q15231376, whose own description reads "battle of the Mali War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
